title: [SharePoint Graph] Follow-up corrections for UpdateListItem and drive item telemetry
summary: SharePoint Graph client corrections preserve unmodified fields during UpdateListItem operations and improve drive item telemetry with operation name dimensions.
key_points: UpdateListItem preserves ContentType, WebUrl, CreatedDateTime, and LastModifiedDateTime fields when record already exists
ParseListItemFieldValueSet returns Boolean and reports parse errors under new event ID 0000UKW
Drive item update operations include OperationName dimension for better telemetry distinguishability
GetListItem keeps default $expand=fields parameter to prevent mutation of caller's parameters
Tests added to protect against parameter leakage and verify field preservation
